rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual choice when someone is baffled or cannot make sense of something.

example.english: After they finished explaining all that jargon, I was completely puzzled.
example.traditional: 佢講完嗰堆專業術語，我即刻一頭霧水。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 go2 deoi1 zyun1 jip6 seot6 jyu5 ngo5 zik1 hak1 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when the puzzlement specifically comes from not understanding something.

example.english: The print on this form is too small, so I’m puzzled about how to fill it in.
example.traditional: 呢份表格啲字太細，我真係唔明點填。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan2 biu2 gaak3 di1 zi6 taai3 sai3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 ming4 dim2 tin4

rows.note: Use this more formal choice when describing someone as perplexed, especially in careful speech or writing.

example.traditional: 呢個結果令我哋感到困惑。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 git3 gwo2 ling6 ngo5 dei6 gam2 dou3 kwan3 waak6
